claims.value: The Austrian staff history lists the column marching towards Hausen at 16,420 men and 780 riders, excluding Extrakorps; 54 guns are listed separately.
claims.rationale: Marching-out establishment, not all Austrian formations available or a dated total actually engaged; the footnote lists excluded staff, pioneers and corps artillery personnel. English rendering (ours): "Total excluding Extrakorps: 16,420 men, 780 riders, 54 guns."

claims.rationale: Narrative subset comparison, not matched people returns or the whole available armies. English rendering (ours): "Around eleven, the Austrian third corps and half the French third corps, of approximately equal strength, were heavily engaged."
